newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Downside tugs T-bonds, support at 109-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Downside tugs T-bonds, support at 109-16.

text.p: T-bond futures were set to drift slightly lower but with a limited downside on Thursday ahead of key U.S. payrolls data on Friday, technical analysts said.

"I expect the T-bond to trade a bit lower today. I have a target of 109-20 and then more or less above 109-16 is an intra-day congestion area," said Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International in London.

Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank here said the contract would need to pierce strong resistance at 110-09 to make any significant headway, slipping lower in the meantime.
By 1020 GMT, T-bonds were 4/32 lower at 109-29.
"We think the market is pretty near the top of the range for now," Celaya said.
"Quicker momentum oscillators are already overbought...so we think we'll probably get a move back below 110-00."

He said below 110-00 the contract would gravitate to support at 109-12, the low from June 2 when the contract started to nudge higher. Below there, he pegged support at 109-00 and the trendline at 108-00.
Liu said any upside should be limited to 110-05, a level it failed to conquer on Wednesday.
"If we do start getting above 110-09 you're going to get a lot of stop loss buying and it would no longer be a consolidation zone but a breakout with targets to 111-30 and 112-09," Celaya said.
"It would be an explosive breakout," he said.
Liu said if the market could not break higher in the near term then a much deeper setback would be expected.
By 1054 GMT, September Eurodollars were 0.015 lower at 94.000.
